title: US Federal Reserve signals more interest rate rises as gold falls to a one-year low
caption:
Minutes from the US Federal Reserve's October meeting show almost all officials expect further interest rate rises, after the Fed held its key rate at 3.75% to 4% in a 10 to 2 vote. Gold fell about 3% on Wednesday to its lowest level in more than a year. The Fed's next rate decision is due in December, and higher rates would make loans and mortgages more expensive.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
